Hi Elodie — great to connect. Attaching a compact rate sheet for quick reference; summary below. Happy to hop on a short call if you want line-by-line.

Baseline hosted API (list prices, USD) — per 1k tokens (generation) / per embedding unit:
- US-hosted standard model: $0.003 / $0.0004 (embeddings)
- Higher-capacity model (opt): $0.006 / $0.0006

EU data-residency options (how we represent on billing):
- Option A: Per-token residency adder — explicit surcharge that appears as a separate invoice line (recommended for chargeback). Typical adder = +12% on per-token charge.
- Option B: Region-priced variants — show EU rate as distinct SKU (e.g., HOSTED-GEN-EU) with the full rate already baked in. This shows as a single line but differentiates region pricing.

Discounts / commits: we offer tiered committed discounts (volume-based). For initial pilots we typically propose a trial credit + an introductory 10% committed-first-year discount for a 12-month minimum commitment.

Regarding invoice line items: we can emit either separate surcharge lines (Option A) or region SKUs (Option B). If procurement needs a specific description, we typically use:
- \"HOSTED-GEN (US) - 1k tokens\" and \"EU Data Residency Surcharge - HOSTED-GEN\" OR
- \"HOSTED-GEN-EU - 1k tokens\" when using region-skud pricing.

If you prefer, I can loop in Finance to confirm accounting/tax wording — cc’ing Laura and Ben.

Thanks,

Hi Hannah —

Short answers below, and I pulled sample line items you can share. We can absolutely emit a separate invoice line for the residency add-on — that’s our standard for customers who need entity-level chargeback. Implementation notes: we tag usage by region at billing-time and insert a separate line item with SKU \"EU-RESIDENCY-SURCHARGE\".

Tax/VAT treatment:
- Residency surcharge is considered a service surcharge, so VAT applies based on the billing entity and customer location. For your 50/50 split example (Novahost EU legal entity representing EU traffic): 
  - Line 1: HOSTED-GEN (US) — 500k tokens @ $0.003 = $1,500.00
  - Line 2: HOSTED-GEN (US) embeddings — 50k @ $0.0004 = $20.00
  - Line 3: HOSTED-GEN (EU) — 500k tokens @ $0.00336 (US base + 12% adder) = $1,680.00 OR
  - Line 4 (if using explicit surcharge): HOSTED-GEN (EU base billed at US rate) — 500k tokens @ $0.003 = $1,500.00
    - Line 5: EU-RESIDENCY-SURCHARGE — 500k tokens @ $0.00036 (12% of per-token) = $180.00
  - VAT is then applied to lines billed to the EU legal entity per local rules; the separate surcharge line is taxable in the same manner as the service line.

Commit thresholds for 10% first-year discount:
- Standard: 12-month commitment with minimum $25k/month ARR (billed monthly) OR $200k annual commit.
- Pilot flexibility: for proof-of-concept pilots under $5k/month we can provide trial credits and reserve the 10% intro discount for customers that convert to a 12-month commit within 60 days of pilot end.

Suggested invoice descriptions to send back to procurement:
- \"HOSTED-GEN - US - 1k tokens\"
- \"HOSTED-GEN - EU - 1k tokens\" OR when using surcharge: \"HOSTED-GEN - 1k tokens\" and \"EU-RESIDENCY-SURCHARGE - 1k tokens\"

I can also provide a CSV example of invoice lines (small sample) — happy to attach one for clarity.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
